result.title: Who gets the information? An $α$-fair label-coverage framework for multi-label feature selection
result.comment: 25 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Supplementary material is provided as an ancillary file
result.summary: Recent information-theoretic filters for multi-label feature selection disagree on how to distribute relevance over labels: some amplify features that inform a few labels, others balance what every label receives. We show these choices are implicit social welfare functions. Treating labels as agents whose utility is the information they receive, we propose FLIC, which greedily maximises the $α$-fair welfare of per-label information coverage. A single parameter $α$ moves from utilitarian ($α=0$) through proportionally fair ($α=1$) to max-min selection ($α\to\infty$), and a dozen published relevance terms lie on this axis, most as special cases, first-order approximations or limits. The objective is monotone submodular for every $α\ge0$ whenever each label's information is, so greedy selection is a $(1-1/e)$-approximation; this fails for $α<0$, and the max-min limit is inapproximable. Fano's and the Hellman-Raviv inequalities tie raw coverage to the Bayes Hamming loss and normalised coverage to per-label relative error. FLIC uses bias-corrected, label-wise conditional information and has no relevance-redundancy trade-off parameter. On 22 data sets, FLIC is the best of 14 information-theoretic filters on seven of nine metrics, winning 86 of 117 pairwise comparisons significantly and losing none significantly. Among 17 methods it ranks first on ranking loss, coverage and macro-AUC with two classifiers and has the best mean rank (narrowly with ML-kNN), while three embedded methods lead on Hamming loss, one-error and micro-F1.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将多标签特征选择中的相关性分配视为社会选择问题，提出 FLIC：把每个标签当作领取信息的「agent」，用单一参数 α 在功利主义、比例公平与 max-min 之间滑动，最大化 per-label 信息覆盖的 α-fair 福利，并证明目标在 α≥0 时单调子模、贪心可得 (1−1/e) 近似，在 22 个数据集上与 14 种信息论过滤器比较。
AI.relevance_reason: 其 α-fair 福利族提供了一种刻画「信息在多个受体间如何分配」的目标形式，可能可供核查于共享 latent 状态中按标签/子任务平衡信息覆盖、避免部分任务信息被吞没的问题，子模性与近似保证也可作为证据筛选或容量分配的参考；但原文是非视觉的表格特征选择，迁移属推测。
